title: Principal Counsel, Africa Legal
description:
About Zipline
 Zipline is the world's largest and most experienced drone delivery service. We are on a mission to serve all humans equally by ensuring access to food, medicine and essential goods anytime, anywhere. We design, build, and operate the world's largest autonomous logistics system, delivering critical supplies quickly and reliably. Today, Zipline operates on four continents, makes a delivery somewhere in the world every 30 seconds, and has completed millions of deliveries to date, including blood, vaccines, medical supplies, food, and retail products.
 Our customers include the world's largest and most prominent healthcare systems, governments, retailers, restaurants and global businesses who rely on us to save lives, reduce emissions, increase economic opportunity, and provide delivery from point A to point B as fast as possible. The drone is only 15% of what we've built to enable seamless, reliable, global operations.
 Our system strengthens supply chains, reduces congestion, and gives people time back. With more than 140 million commercial autonomous miles safely flown, Zipline is redefining access to healthcare, consumer products, and food across the globe.
 We operate at a global scale and are looking for practical problem solvers who thrive on real-world challenges and rapid growth. Our team is motivated by building systems that have a direct, meaningful impact on people's lives and by scaling the future of logistics. We are seeking people who sculpt from first principles, enjoy facing adversity, and can do the impossible at record breaking speeds.
 About You and The Role
 Zipline is seeking a senior, strategic, and highly adaptable lawyer to lead and scale legal and compliance across multiple countries of operation in Africa. This role sits at the intersection of compliance execution and regulatory strategy and is critical to enabling Zipline's continued growth in complex and evolving regulatory environments.

title: FMEA Moderator/ Consutant (m/w/d) - VDA & mehr
description:
QMH Consulting unterstützt Unternehmen aus Automotive, MedTech, Maschinenbau und Elektronik dabei, FMEA normkonform, auditfest und praxistauglich in ihre Prozesse zu integrieren.
 Dafür suchen wir eine/-n FMEA-Moderator / Consultant (m/w/d), der/die Projekte methodensicher führt, Teams strukturiert durch die 7 Schritte leitet und Ergebnisse schafft, die Audits bestehen und im Alltag wirken.
 Aufgaben Aufgaben
 Moderation von Design- und Prozess-FMEA nach AIAG/VDA in Entwicklungs- und Serienprojekten
 Strukturierung und Durchführung der 7 Schritte inkl. Funktions-, Fehler-, Risiko- und Maßnahmenanalyse
 Dokumentation in APIS, PLATO oder kundenspezifischen Tools; Pflege von Struktur- und Netzansichten
 FMEA-Reviews: Plausibilitäts-, Vollständigkeits- und Wirksamkeitschecks; Ableitung von Verbesserungen
 FMEA-Prozessaufbau: Rollen, Templates, Timings, Schnittstellen (APQP, Control Plan, SPC)
 Training & Coaching von Fachabteilungen bis zur Moderatorenqualifikation
 Vorbereitung auf Kunden-/Auditorenanforderungen (z. B. VDA 6.3) und Unterstützung bei Freigaben
 Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Entwicklung, Qualität, Produktion, Lieferanten und Projektleitung
 Qualifikation Qualifikation
 Technisches Studium oder vergleichbare Qualifikation (z. B. Techniker:in/Meister:in)
 Praxis in FMEA-Moderation (D-/P-FMEA) nach AIAG/VDA – idealerweise in Automotive oder regulierten Branchen
 Sicherer Umgang mit APIS oder PLATO (alternativ schnelle Auffassungsgabe für neue Tools)
 Erfahrung in Prozess-/Produktentwicklung, Qualität oder Produktion
 Methodensicherheit, klare Kommunikation und stringente Moderation heterogener Teams
 Sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse; Reisebereitschaft für Workshops beim Kunden (nach Bedarf)

 Überdurchschnittliche Vergütung und attraktive Zusatzleistungen
 Flexible Arbeitszeiten, 100 % Remote möglich, klare Prozesse
 Unbefristeter Vertrag und strukturierte Einarbeitung

title: Project Manager Innovation Bank Transaction Systems
description:
coni + partner, established 1993, is a consultancy company with headquarters in Zurich and subsidiaries in Düsseldorf and Shanghai. We are specialised in custom-fit staffing in tune with the corporate culture by ensuring a perfect match of professional skills, references and personal as well as social skills of successful candidates.
 Our client is an international bank in Zurich. We are searching for a payment or transaction specialist (m, f, d) as
 Project Manager Innovation Bank Transaction Systems
 Your Tasks:
 As a member of a team responsible for the smooth functioning of payment system operations / Analyse all incoming/outgoing payments e.g. large-value and mass payments in connection with services provided by financial market participants / Analyse the interbank alerts and the bank's crisis organization / Promoting the continuous improvement of payment processes and transformative change across the bank, including AI and its potential applications within the filtering systems designed to combat sanctions and payment fraud / Working closely with the business and IT teams to support colleagues with complex issues, with the aim of improving efficiency, the quality of transactions and services as well as operational stability / Monitoring transaction regulations and ensuring compliance with new regulatory standards by providing support with their implementation / Ensure that the process and control documentation is updated / Point of contact for enquiries regarding payment transactions and customer support / Involvement in various projects.

title: Software Engineer
description:
Cato Networks is the converged network and security cloud for the AI era. 

As AI reshapes cybersecurity, enterprises face a dual challenge: unlocking AI’s potential while defending against AI-driven attacks. Cato addresses both through a unified, cloud-native platform, providing the visibility and context to prioritize risks and stop threats in real time across users, applications, data, and AI agents. 

Join us as we scale: take on ambitious technological challenges and shape the next generation of enterprise security at a company trusted by thousands of organizations worldwide.
